name: Recreus Filaflex 95A Foamy

retraction.note: From the full-bed seam test printed on the MK3S (FOAM99_45PAIRS, 21 October 2026: 45 pairs of 20 mm two-line circles, every travel lifted 0.2 mm at 180 mm/s): cleanest at 238 C with 1 mm retraction at 40 mm/s, pushed back exactly 1 mm at 20 mm/s (2.5 mm also good); 75 mm/s retraction lost circles; a 0.2 mm seam gap looked good (tried at 245 C). The lift on a travel is z_hop and the travel speed travel_speed_hint. Before: 4 mm at 65, 4.2 back, 3 mm lift, 248 C left a knot and strings at every seam.

notes: Dry at 55 C for at least 1 h. Direct-drive extruder recommended. Foams at 245-250 C; lower flow and higher temperature foam more. 238 C (from 21 October 2026, below Recreus's 248 C) strings least on the MK3S and foams a little less: check a swatch's weight and width.
